vb_textbox.text: The colours of the mushroom hats dont matter at all; the shape is the most important. I found that in the first half of the game the longer, thinner hats yielded more points until it showed 3+ mushrooms, once you had that then I tried once or twice more before switching to the flatter mushroom hat. I found that the grey flat mushroom hat yielded the most points when the basket was in the wintery scene and I think that although the colour of the hats did not matter, the more muted tone hats led to the winter scene so look out for that.
